Name: Avatar Onslaught
Overview: Avatar Onslaught pits the player against an endless army of advancing Xbox Avatars in a water balloon fight. The player must throw balloons at the advancing avatars before they reach the red line on the ground, while also avoiding the balloons they are throwing at the player's avatar. There are several types of enemies, as well as destructible shields that will protect the player from enemy balloons and can also be repaired. Between waves, the player can choose from a number of upgrades, including reload speed, throw speed, and ammo count. If five enemy avatars reach the player, the game is over.
